contracts: Every changed test/fixture from every core fork is retained under its lane; untouched baseline tests run at the package root.
Unsafe/malformed project diagnostics use PROJECT_CONFIG_IGNORED across all adapters instead of three lane-specific spellings.
All protected writers use the no-follow 0700 .write-lock lease (5s stale, up to 12s wait); legacy .lock files are inert, not removed. Tests address the unified lease path and bounded wait.
Setup advances the disable epoch as well as disable itself, so previously captured content cannot survive privacy or route reconfiguration.
Delivery receipts use deliveryStatePath, never the obsolete agent-wide activation file.
Pi scope-selection semantics win over silently repairing edited repository routes during credential rotation: reject before validation, preserving the saved profile.
Canonical costs use gen_ai.cost.total, TTFT is native-only milliseconds, and turn totals have one additive owner.
The retained unknown-host test now names unknown-host because Hermes has an implemented home-directory resolver.
Malformed repository JSON is ignored with a diagnostic across all adapters (including the Copilot test that previously expected a thrown error).
Full bounded draining replaces one-batch shutdown: a wholly rate-limited queue reports RATE_LIMITED, not an artificial SHUTDOWN_BUDGET.

The compaction regression now counts the separately declared turn-plan root once (three owners / 360 tokens / 0.03 across three test turns), while unknown-plan and overlapping compaction summaries remain nonadditive.
